subject: Shared test-case catalog & escrow checklist
messages:
From: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@acuityretail.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-06-10T09:14:00Z
Subject: Exchange: test-case catalog + next steps

Hi Mateo,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the latency numbers look promising. As discussed, Acuity is ready to share a scoped set of evaluation testcases and a small prompt pack so your team can run a short acceptance sweep against the Redwood hosted endpoint.

We want to keep this initial exchange tightly scoped: 1200 testcases (anonymized), a 45-prompt prompt pack, and an export of expected labels. Usage constraints: samples are for evaluation only, non-production, retained for 30 days after the acceptance window, and cannot be used to further train or benchmark publicly.

Can you send a mutual action plan (MAP) with timelines, a suggested acceptance gate (pass/fail thresholds), and your escrow checklist? We have legal/security on the thread (copied in subsequent emails) and will need an explicit takedown schedule.

Attached: a brief inventory (metadata only) of the materials we'll share.

Best,
Sarah
Sarah Jenkins
Senior Product Manager — Evaluation & ML
Acuity Retail

Attachment: acuity_asset_inventory.csv (metadata only)

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@acuityretail.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>; Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-10T12:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Exchange: test-case catalog + next steps

Hi Sarah — appreciate the clear scope.

High-level MAP (draft):
- Week 0 (this week): Exchange metadata + signed narrow-scope addendum (attached).
- Week 1: Ingest prompt pack & testcases to a sandbox project on Redwood Dedicated; run smoke validation.
- Week 2: Automated acceptance sweep (scripted run of the 1200 cases), quality/latency report back to Acuity.
- Day 15: Acceptance window closes; both sides sign acceptance or list regressions.
- Day 30: Automatic takedown and destructive purge of source files from Redwood ephemeral store.

Acceptance gate proposal (suggested):
- Latency: median token latency <= 12ms on p95 payload distribution you shared.
- Quality: top-line metric (weighted accuracy) >= 87% against labeled ground truth; regressions prioritized if delta > 3pts.
- No model outputs will be stored beyond ephemeral cache except for trimmed logs used for debugging (30 days max).

I'm attaching a one-page MAP workbook and an escrow manifest template. Karthik has offered to run legal/escrow language and Monica will coordinate the sandbox ingest and keys.

We can sign the addendum via DocuSign once you approve the timelines. Next step: can you confirm the earliest date you can transfer SFTP/Drive links?

Thanks,
Mateo
Sr. Solutions — Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_draft.xlsx; escrow_manifest.csv

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@acuityretail.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-11T08:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Exchange: test-case catalog + next steps — escrow & retention

Sarah, Mateo — quick legal/security notes.

I've reviewed the MAP and escrow manifest. A few clarifications and a small redline:
1) Retention window: Acuity's 30-day retention on Redwood ephemeral store is fine; we propose a 5-business-day verified purge confirmation step where we provide a signed purge certificate.
2) Training prohibition: we will add explicit contractual language that Redwood will not use the material for training or model improvement outside of the scoped acceptance sweep; any internal diagnostics will be on redacted/aggregated stats only.
3) Escrow: we ask for a minimal escrow deposit of the testcases manifest (hashes + provenance) with a neutral third-party escrow provider only if materials exceed 50k tokens; for your scope it's optional but included in the attached redline for transparency.

I've attached redlined escrow language (docx). If you prefer, we can push the legal redline into the same addendum and route for signature in one DocuSign envelope.

Karthik
Head of Legal — Redwood Inference

Attachment: redline_ESCROW_terms.docx

From: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@acuityretail.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-06-12T13:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Exchange: test-case catalog + next steps — escrow & retention

Thanks Karthik — that all looks reasonable. A couple of follow-ups from Acuity legal/security:
- We want the purge certificate to include a salted hash of filenames (not the files) and a timestamp; that will be sufficient for our auditors.
- Escrow optionality: we don't require third-party escrow for this pilot; please keep the option if we expand.
- Acceptance gate: can you add a small clause that allows Acuity to request a one-week remediation window in case of borderline failures (delta between 1–3 points)?

I attached a short redline to your MAP workbook with these asks. We can sign the addendum once those pieces are in.

I'll push the dataset next Tuesday (2026-06-16) morning — SFTP details to follow.

Best,
Sarah

Attachment: Acuity_redline_MAP.xlsx

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@acuityretail.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-12T16:41:00Z
Subject: Re: Exchange: test-case catalog + next steps — escrow & retention

Sarah — perfect. We'll incorporate the salted-hash purge certificate and add the one-week remediation window into the acceptance gate (only for borderline deltas).

Plan of record after your push on 2026-06-16:
- 06/16 morning: Acuity uploads to SFTP (Creds to be exchanged via our secure keyshare).
- 06/16 afternoon: Redwood ingestion into ephemeral sandbox project (Monica owns).
- 06/17–06/19: Acceptance sweep; daily digest to both teams.
- 06/19 EOD: Acceptance decision, remediation request if needed.
- 07/16: Final destructive purge + signed purge certificate delivered (30 days after acceptance).

DocuSign workflow: Karthik will consolidate redlines into one addendum and we'll route for signature by EOD 06/13 so ingestion can proceed on 06/16.

I added a short checklist in the MAP workbook for onboarding keys and telemetry knobs.

Thanks — looking forward to the run.
Mateo

Attachment: Redwood_MAP_draft_v2.xlsx; onboarding-checklist.txt

From: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@acuityretail.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-15T17:46:00Z
Subject: Re: Exchange: test-case catalog + next steps — escrow & retention

Mateo/Karthik/Monica — all set on our side.

SFTP will open 06/16 09:00 PT. I'll DM SFTP credentials to Mateo and Monica via our secure channel (per the onboarding checklist). Our legal has signed the addendum and we've uploaded the asset bundle to the SFTP (metadata + encrypted archive).

A couple of operational notes:
- Promptpack is zipped and labeled with the checksum in the manifest.
- We included a small subset (50 "canary" cases) that we request Redwood run first before the full sweep.

Thanks for the quick turnaround on the MAP — excited to get started.

Cheers,
Sarah
